  plaque.createButton({

    _G[fnName] = function() runSetup(p) end

      label = tostring(p) .. "P",
      position = {x, 0.25, -0.32},

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1-5P Setup Automation
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function runSetup(playerCount)
  local rules = SETUP_RULES[playerCount]
  if not rules then return end
  state.playerCount = playerCount
  state.round = 1
  state.firstPlayerIdx = 1

  -- 1. Set all 6 Warehouse counters
  for _, guid in ipairs(CONFIG.guids.warehouseCounters) do
    local c = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if c then
      c.call("setValue", rules.warehouse)
    end
  end

  -- 2. Shuffle Target Deck
  local targetDeck = getObjectFromGUID(CONFIG.guids.targetDeck)
  if targetDeck then
    targetDeck.shuffle()
  end

  -- 3. Shuffle Quest Deck and deal 1 Quest Card face up onto the Tiles Board
  local questDeck = getObjectFromGUID(CONFIG.guids.questDeck)
  if questDeck then
    questDeck.shuffle()
    questDeck.takeObject({
      position = CONFIG.positions.activeQuest,
      rotation = {0, 180, 0},
      smooth = true
    })
  end

  -- 4. Build the exact v7.0 Encounter Deck from Boons, Burdens, and Arrivals
  local drawPos = CONFIG.positions.encounterDraw
  local pulled = {}
  local function takeCards(deckGuid, count)
    local deck = getObjectFromGUID(deckGuid)
    if not deck then return end
    deck.shuffle()
    for i = 1, count do
      if deck.getQuantity() > 1 then
        local card = deck.takeObject({
          position = {drawPos[1], drawPos[2] + 0.3 + (#pulled * 0.04), drawPos[3]},
          rotation = {0, 180, 180},
          smooth = false
        })
        if card then table.insert(pulled, card) end
      elseif deck.getQuantity() == 1 then
        deck.setPosition({drawPos[1], drawPos[2] + 0.3 + (#pulled * 0.04), drawPos[3]})
        deck.setRotation({0, 180, 180})
        table.insert(pulled, deck)
        break
      end
    end
  end

  takeCards(CONFIG.guids.boonsDeck, rules.boons)
  takeCards(CONFIG.guids.burdensDeck, rules.burdens)
  takeCards(CONFIG.guids.arrivalsDeck, rules.arrivals)

  Wait.time(function()
    -- Find newly formed deck at Encounter Draw well and shuffle it
    local hits = Physics.cast({
      origin = {drawPos[1], drawPos[2] + 4, drawPos[3]},
      direction = {0, -1, 0},
      type = 3,
      size = {2.2, 4, 3.2},
      max_distance = 6
    })
    for _, hit in ipairs(hits) do
      if hit.hit_object and hit.hit_object.tag == "Deck" then
        hit.hit_object.setName("Encounter Deck (" .. tostring(playerCount) .. "P)")
        hit.hit_object.shuffle()
        break
      end
    end
  end, 0.9)

  -- 5. Place Round Marker on Round 1 & Player 1 Marker at Seat 1
  moveRoundMarker(1)
  movePlayer1Marker(1)

  buildControlPlaqueUI()
  broadcastToAll(
    string.format(
      "Setup complete for %dP! Actions/turn: %d | Starting Warehouse: %d each | Encounters: %d Boons, %d Burdens, %d Arrivals.",
      playerCount, rules.actions, rules.warehouse, rules.boons, rules.burdens, rules.arrivals
    ),
    {0.94, 0.84, 0.56}
  )
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- End-of-Round Cleanup, Round Marker & Player 1 Rotation
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function moveRoundMarker(roundNum)
  local marker = getObjectFromGUID(CONFIG.guids.roundMarker)
  local pos = CONFIG.positions.roundSockets[roundNum]
  if marker and pos then
    marker.setPositionSmooth({pos[1], pos[2] + 0.25, pos[3]}, false, true)
    marker.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 0}, false, true)
  end
end

function movePlayer1Marker(seatIdx)
  local marker = getObjectFromGUID(CONFIG.guids.player1Marker)
  local pos = CONFIG.positions.seatMarkers[seatIdx]
  if marker and pos then
    marker.setPositionSmooth({pos[1], pos[2] + 0.3, pos[3]}, false, true)
    marker.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 0}, false, true)
  end
end

function onRotateP1()
  state.firstPlayerIdx = (state.firstPlayerIdx % state.playerCount) + 1
  movePlayer1Marker(state.firstPlayerIdx)
  broadcastToAll("Player 1 marker rotated to Seat " .. tostring(state.firstPlayerIdx) .. ".", {0.92, 0.84, 0.62})
end

function onEndRound()
  -- 1. Sweep all X Cooldown tokens off the Map Board
  local bounds = CONFIG.mapBounds
  local cleared = 0
  for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
    if obj.getName() == "Cooldown X" and not obj.getLock() then
      local p = obj.getPosition()
      if p.x >= bounds.minX and p.x <= bounds.maxX and p.z >= bounds.minZ and p.z <= bounds.maxZ then
        obj.destruct()
        cleared = cleared + 1
      end
    end
  end

  -- 2. Advance Round & rotate Player 1 marker
  if state.round < 12 then
    state.round = state.round + 1
    moveRoundMarker(state.round)
    state.firstPlayerIdx = (state.firstPlayerIdx % state.playerCount) + 1
    movePlayer1Marker(state.firstPlayerIdx)
    buildControlPlaqueUI()

    local seasonMsg = ""
    if state.round == 5 then
      seasonMsg = " — SEASON II BEGINS! Refresh Steward powers."
    elseif state.round == 9 then
      seasonMsg = " — SEASON III BEGINS! Refresh Steward powers."
    end
    broadcastToAll(
      string.format("Round %d begins (cleared %d X tokens, Player 1 -> Seat %d)%s",
        state.round, cleared, state.firstPlayerIdx, seasonMsg),
      {0.84, 0.94, 0.78}
    )
  else
    broadcastToAll(
      string.format("Round 12 complete (cleared %d X tokens)! Proceed to Final Scoring.", cleared),
      {0.98, 0.84, 0.44}
    )
  end
end

    color = {0.58, 0.44, 0.18},
    font_color = {0.98, 0.95, 0.86},
    tooltip = "Pull Special Tile #" .. tostring(state.unlockNum) .. " from the reserve bag onto the Tiles Board (0 Actions to place)."
  })
end

function onUnlockPrev(_, _, alt)
  local step = alt and 5 or 1
  state.unlockNum = ((state.unlockNum - 1 - step) % 26) + 1
  buildUnlockPlaqueUI()
end

function onUnlockNext(_, _, alt)
  local step = alt and 5 or 1
  state.unlockNum = ((state.unlockNum - 1 + step) % 26) + 1
  buildUnlockPlaqueUI()
end

function onUnlockTile()
  local bag = getObjectFromGUID(CONFIG.guids.specialBag)
  if not bag then
    broadcastToAll("Special Tiles reserve bag not found.", {0.95, 0.45, 0.45})
    return
  end
  local prefix = "#" .. tostring(state.unlockNum) .. " "
  local targetPos = CONFIG.positions.unlockedSpecial
  for _, entry in ipairs(bag.getObjects()) do
    if string.sub(entry.name, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
      bag.takeObject({
        guid = entry.guid,
        position = {targetPos[1] + math.random(-8, 8) * 0.08, targetPos[2] + 0.6, targetPos[3] + math.random(-5, 5) * 0.08},
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        smooth = true
      })
      broadcastToAll("Unlocked Special Tile " .. entry.name .. " (0 Actions to place)!", {0.94, 0.84, 0.52})
      return
    end
  end
  broadcastToAll("Special Tile #" .. tostring(state.unlockNum) .. " is already unlocked (not in reserve bag).", {0.95, 0.72, 0.42})
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- Clickable 0-15 Warehouse Resource Counter for The Quiet Vale (v7.0)
local MIN_VAL = 0
local MAX_VAL = 15

value = 0
resourceName = ""

function onLoad(saved_data)
  if saved_data and saved_data ~= "" then
    local ok, data = pcall(JSON.decode, saved_data)
    if ok and type(data) == "table" and type(data.value) == "number" then
      value = math.max(MIN_VAL, math.min(MAX_VAL, math.floor(data.value)))
    end
  end
  resourceName = self.getName()
  buildUI()
end

function onSave()
  return JSON.encode({ value = value })
end

function setValue(newVal)
  local n = tonumber(newVal) or 0
  value = math.max(MIN_VAL, math.min(MAX_VAL, math.floor(n)))
  updateDisplay()
  return value
end

function getValue()
  return value
end

function adjust(delta)
  local prev = value
  value = math.max(MIN_VAL, math.min(MAX_VAL, value + delta))
  updateDisplay()
  if value ~= prev then
    broadcastToAll(resourceName .. ": " .. tostring(value) .. " / 15", {0.9, 0.84, 0.68})
  end
end

  adjust(alt and 5 or 1)
end

  adjust(alt and -5 or -1)

  adjust(alt and -1 or 1)

  self.editButton({ index = 0, label = tostring(value) })

    height = 560,
    font_size = 420,
    color = {0.14, 0.12, 0.10, 0.92},
    font_color = {0.96, 0.90, 0.72},
    tooltip = resourceName .. " (Left-click +1, Right-click -1, Cap 15)"
  })
  self.createButton({
    click_function = "onMinus",
    function_owner = self,
    label = "-",
    position = {-0.72, 0.25, 0},
    rotation = {0, 0, 0},
    width = 240,
    height = 360,
    font_size = 280,
    color = {0.36, 0.22, 0.20},
    font_color = {0.98, 0.92, 0.84},
    tooltip = "-1 (Right-click -5)"
  })
  self.createButton({
    click_function = "onPlus",
    function_owner = self,
    label = "+",
    position = {0.72, 0.25, 0},
    rotation = {0, 0, 0},
    width = 240,
    height = 360,
    font_size = 280,
    color = {0.22, 0.36, 0.24},
    font_color = {0.94, 0.98, 0.90},
    tooltip = "+1 (Right-click +5)"
  })
end

Bottom (Goal): The Four Storehouses — End with at least the number in the table of each: Lumber Yard, Mine Tunnel, Gathering Outpost and Farmstead.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): The Mine Road — End with Mine Tunnels (see table), each beside a Travel tile.
Bottom (Goal): The Resource Crown — End with kinds of Resource tile (see table) that each have two copies placed, both upgraded.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): The Fair Day — Have Merchant tiles (see table), each beside a Housing, a Social and a Travel tile.
Bottom (Goal): The Heart of the Vale — Ring one tile with six others, the seven covering different categories (see table). At 4 to 5 players, none of the seven may hold Strain.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): Shelter and Song — End with a connected Housing cluster (size in table) beside both a Social and a Wellbeing tile.
Bottom (Goal): One Great Hearth — End with one connected cluster of Housing tiles (size in table).

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): The Care Ring — Have Care Rings (see table): a Wellbeing tile ringed by six tiles, at least 4 of them Housing, Social or Wellbeing.
Bottom (Goal): Garden Community — End with a Common Land ringed by six tiles, with Housing tiles in the ring (see table). At 4 to 5 players, none of the seven may hold Strain.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): The Quiet Courtyard — Have courtyards (see table): six tiles ringed round an empty hex, in at least 4 categories.
Bottom (Goal): The Ring Road — Make a closed loop of Travel tiles with tiles inside it (see table).

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): Mended Before Nightfall — In a single round, remove Strain (see table) from tiles in at least 2 categories (any tiles when solo).
Bottom (Goal): The Vale Bent, Not Broken — Have Overstrained tiles at the same time (see table), then end the game with none.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): Sheltered District — End with Supported tiles (see table) across at least 3 categories (2 when solo).
Bottom (Vow): Not One Lost — No tile may ever be Overstrained (at 4 to 5 players, one may be Overstrained at a time). End with no more Strain on the map than the table shows.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): Good Work Made Last — Upgrade tiles over the course of the game (see table).
Bottom (Vow): No Fine Work — Never upgrade a Core tile, by any means. End with Housing tiles (see table), each beside another Housing tile.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): Work and Rest — End with a Washhouse beside a Crafting, a Merchant and a Social tile, and also a Housing tile at 4 to 5 players.
Bottom (Vow): The Unbroken Vale — At no time may more tiles hold 2 or more Strain than the table shows.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): The Market Track — End with Workshops and Market Stalls (see table for each), all beside the same Track.
Bottom (Vow): No Roads Raised — Never place a Travel tile, by any means (Common Land counts as Travel). End with tiles in different categories (see table).

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): The Crossroads — Have a Travel tile beside three other Travel tiles and a Merchant tile.
Bottom (Goal): The Long Road — Make one connected line of Travel tiles joining the rows in the table. At 4 to 5 players it must also join column A to column N.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): The River Is Welcomed — End with tiles beside River/Water from Housing, Merchant, Social and Wellbeing: as many different kinds as the table shows.
Bottom (Goal): Twin Villages — On each bank, end with a Housing cluster (size in table) beside a Social tile, and join the banks with a Bridge.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): Hearths in Every Land — End with Housing tiles on different terrains (see table), not counting Grasslands.
Bottom (Vow): One Village — Every Housing tile must join the one Housing cluster when it is placed. End with that cluster at the size in the table.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): Bread, Stone and Timber — End with a Lumber Yard, Mine Tunnel and Farmstead all beside one connected Travel group, and also a Gathering Outpost at 4 to 5 players.
Bottom (Vow): No Road Through — No Travel tile may ever be beside a Housing tile. End with tiles in different categories (see table).

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description:
Top (Goal): Stone over Running Water — End with Bridges (see table), at least one upgraded to Stone Bridge.
Bottom (Goal): Clean Slate — End the game with no more Strain on the map than the table shows.
